# Nexus Estate API repository instructions

The canonical coding-agent instructions are in `/AGENTS.md`.

Before planning, reviewing, or modifying code:

1. Read `/AGENTS.md` completely.
2. Follow every applicable MUST/MUST NOT rule.
3. For migrations, apply all `MIG-*` rules before creating or renaming files.
4. Use `docs/developer.rules.md` only for deeper architecture rationale.
5. Do not treat existing code or green CI as permission to violate
   `/AGENTS.md`.

When instructions conflict, `/AGENTS.md` is the repository's operational
source of truth.
